nodes.label: Y-Cinema API stack: Fastify + Prisma/PostgreSQL + Redis + Meilisearch + BullMQ
ESLint-enforced layering rule: src/providers/** cannot import services/modules/routes/admin
nodes.rationale: Architecture rule from docs/ADR.md section 2.2 is enforced mechanically via a custom ESLint rule, not just documented convention, so provider adapters (tmdb, anilist, tvmaze, jikan, fanart, omdb, kitsu) stay isolated from business logic and cannot create circular/upward dependencies.

nodes.label: Public-deploy hardening checklist (CORS, JWT_SECRET, EXPOSE_DOCS, rate limiting)
nodes.rationale: Designed to run as one central public instance (Stremio/Trakt model) rather than self-hosted per-user; requires NODE_ENV=production (blocks CORS_ORIGIN=* at boot), a real CORS origin list, EXPOSE_DOCS=false by default to avoid publicizing the full /admin/* endpoint surface, a unique JWT_SECRET, and role-differentiated Redis-backed rate limits reviewed against real traffic before going public.

nodes.label: Dev sandbox limitation: built without Docker available
nodes.rationale: Entire backend (149 tests / 34 files) was built and verified via build+lint+typecheck+pure-mock tests in a sandbox without Docker; infra-dependent tests self-skip with an explicit [SKIP] message instead of failing confusingly or false-passing, so real Postgres/Redis/Meilisearch verification must happen before production deploy.

nodes.label: scraper-api (Y-cinema/) legal-risk caveat: not covered by public-deploy hardening
nodes.rationale: The sibling torrent scraper-api project carries its own legal implications if exposed publicly to all users and explicitly needs a separate review before any public deploy — the README calls this out as a distinct concern from the main API's hardening steps.
